screening_answers.question: How many years of experience do you have with React and TypeScript?
screening_answers.answer: 3 years as a Full Stack Developer at a US-based medical-device company, plus personal projects in Next.js, React 19 and TypeScript such as PageForge, site-to-agent and Safey Inventory.

screening_answers.question: Do you have experience with Java and Spring Boot?
screening_answers.answer: No. My back-end work is Node.js and Python (FastAPI) with REST APIs, webhooks, auth and PostgreSQL. I pick up new stacks quickly and would ramp on Java and Spring Boot on the job.

screening_answers.question: Describe your experience with agentic workflows, tool calling and RAG.
screening_answers.answer: I built multi-agent-research-crew (planner, researcher, writer and verifier agents with retries, token budgets and citation checks) and site-to-agent (hybrid BM25 + vector RAG with cited answers and an eval harness). I also built AI agents for internal use at the medical-device company.

screening_answers.question: What is your notice period?
screening_answers.answer: Immediate. My previous role ended in September 2026. I am based in Pune, India.

screening_answers.question: What are your salary expectations?
screening_answers.answer: I am targeting INR 30,000 per month or more and am flexible on structure. What matters to me is the total package and the work.

paragraphs: I am applying for the Software Engineer I (Full Stack) role in Pune. I spent 3 years as a Full Stack Developer at a US-based medical-device company, building web applications, internal AI agents and a CRM. I work in React, TypeScript, REST APIs and PostgreSQL.

The posting asks for agentic workflows, tool calling, streaming and RAG. site-to-agent, my hybrid BM25 + vector retrieval agent with cited answers and an eval harness, covers the RAG part. multi-agent-research-crew covers agent orchestration with retries, token budgets and citation checks. I use Claude Code daily and hold the Claude Code in Action and Claude Code 101 certifications, so AI-assisted engineering is how I already work.

I should be clear that I have no Java or Spring Boot experience. My back-end work is Node.js and FastAPI. I am a fast learner and care about accessible UI, tests and security, having pen-tested 5+ live Play Store apps. I can join immediately. My portfolio is at hussain-singapuri.vercel.app.
